newsitem.title: INDIA: India Corporation Bank plans public issue in Aug.
newsitem.headline: India Corporation Bank plans public issue in Aug.

text.p: Indian state-run Corporation Bank plans its maiden public issue of equity shares in end August to raise 2.66 billion rupees, a bank official said on Wednesday.
The bank plans to offer 38 million shares. Each 10 rupee face value share would be priced at around 70 rupees, he told reporters.
The bank is seeking approval for the issue from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) in June, the bank's chairman and managing director R.S. Hugar said.
Corporation Bank, a major state-run bank, is headquartered in the southern port city of Mangalore.
